title: IELTS Trainer - Part Time Consultant
jobDescription: About Leap Leap has helped 300,000+ students achieve their study abroad dreams across 25+ countries . With 700+ university partnerships and backing from leading global investors, our mission is to make quality international education accessible to every ambitious student. About the Role We're expanding our IELTS training presence in Chennai through our network of partner colleges and are looking for a passionate IELTS Trainer . This is a field-based role where you will travel to assigned partner colleges across Chennai to conduct IELTS preparation classes, workshops, and study abroad seminars. Roles & Responsibilities Visit assigned partner colleges across Chennai to conduct IELTS preparation classes. Deliver IELTS and study abroad awareness seminars and workshops on college campuses. Assess students' English proficiency and provide personalized feedback. Conduct mock IELTS tests and track student progress. Guide students on effective test-taking strategies and exam techniques. Motivate and mentor students throughout their IELTS preparation journey. Build strong relationships with partner college stakeholders to ensure smooth program delivery. Counsel interested students and support enrollments into Leap's IELTS programs. Ideal Persona 1–3 years of experience in IELTS or English language training. Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom management skills. Comfortable traveling across Chennai to conduct classes and seminars at partner colleges. Passionate about teaching, mentoring students, and driving learning outcomes. Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable to a field-based role

title: UG Counselling
jobDescription: About the Role We are looking for an Associate – UG Premium Counseling who will play a critical role in delivering high-quality, personalized counselling services to undergraduate aspirants targeting top global universities. There is minimal management and extreme autonomy. If the above defines you, you will fit in snugly. What is Leap? Leap is a global student mobility platform that empowers students’ aspirations for a global career and education We have built Leap Finance and Leap Scholar and Yocket We work at the exciting intersection of fintech & edtech And we love that we succeed as a business while powering the dreams of talented students! Who are we as people? We have a lean, rockstar team. We have come this far with a lean team because we love to increase the talent density with every new member we add. Yes, we are more picky than the usual company. We hire slowly and deliberately You can meet our founders here -> Arnav Kumar and Vaibhav Singh What will you be doing? Broadly, You will have tearing-your-hair level complex & challenging problems to solve With massive upside if you solve them In a super fast paced environment that will challenge you With enough resources to be audacious And mentorship from an experienced founding team

title: SDE -II
jobDescription: We are looking for a Backend / Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building products end-to-end and is excited about solving real customer problems. You will work closely with Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship impactful features, improve user experiences and build scalable systems that power our core products. This role is ideal for engineers who are equally comfortable building customer-facing experiences and designing scalable backend systems. What You'll Do ● Own product features end-to-end, from problem definition and technical design to implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring. ● Build and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and data models that power our products. ● Develop intuitive, performant, and responsive user interfaces that deliver a great customer experience. ● Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other engineers to translate business requirements into high-quality software solutions. ● Design systems that are reliable, maintainable, and scalable as our product and user base grows. ● Improve application performance, observability, and operational excellence across the stack. ● Write clean, well-tested, and production-ready code while participating actively in code reviews and technical discussions. ● Debug production issues, identify root causes, and drive fixes with a strong sense of ownership. ● Contribute to engineering best practices, tooling, and architectural decisions. What We're Looking For ● 3–5 years of software development experience building and shipping production applications. ● Strong experience building Backend or full-stack applications with meaningful exposure heavily towards Backend development. ● Proficiency in Java and experience with modern backend frameworks. ● Good to have experience with modern frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, or similar frameworks. ● Solid understanding of API design, distributed systems fundamentals, databases, caching, and asynchronous processing. ● Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating with third-party services. ● Good understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, query optimization, and data modeling. ● Familiarity with cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and production debugging. ● Experience writing unit, integration, and automated tests. ● Strong problem-solving ability, product mindset, and attention to detail. ● Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Bonus Points ● Experience building consumer-facing products at scale. ● Experience working in high-growth startups or product companies. ● Exposure to AI/LLM-powered products and workflows. ● Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging systems, and distributed systems. ● Demonstrated ownership of business-critical features or product initiatives.
